name: codeguruprofiler
description: This section provides documentation for the Amazon CodeGuru Profiler API operations.

subcommands.name: add-notification-channels
subcommands.description: Add up to 2 anomaly notifications channels for a profiling group.

subcommands.name: batch-get-frame-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns the time series of values for a requested list of frame metrics from a time period.

subcommands.name: configure-agent
subcommands.description: Used by profiler agents to report their current state and to receive remote configuration updates.

subcommands.name: create-profiling-group
subcommands.description: Creates a profiling group.

subcommands.name: delete-profiling-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a profiling group.

subcommands.name: describe-profiling-group
subcommands.description: Returns a ProfilingGroupDescription object that contains information about the requested profiling group.

subcommands.name: get-findings-report-account-summary
subcommands.description: Returns a list of FindingsReportSummary objects that contain analysis results for all profiling groups in your AWS account.

subcommands.name: get-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Get the current configuration for anomaly notifications for a profiling group.

subcommands.name: get-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the JSON-formatted resource-based policy on a profiling group.

subcommands.name: get-profile
subcommands.description: Gets the aggregated profile of a profiling group for a specified time range.

subcommands.name: get-recommendations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Recommendation objects that contain recommendations for a profiling group for a given time period.

subcommands.name: list-findings-reports
subcommands.description: List the available reports for a given profiling group and time range.

subcommands.name: list-profile-times
subcommands.description: Lists the start times of the available aggregated profiles of a profiling group for an aggregation period within the specified time range.

subcommands.name: list-profiling-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of profiling groups.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags that are assigned to a specified resource.

subcommands.name: post-agent-profile
subcommands.description: Submits profiling data to an aggregated profile of a profiling group.

subcommands.name: put-permission
subcommands.description: Adds permissions to a profiling group's resource-based policy that are provided using an action group.

subcommands.name: remove-notification-channel
subcommands.description: Remove one anomaly notifications channel for a profiling group.

subcommands.name: remove-permission
subcommands.description: Removes permissions from a profiling group's resource-based policy that are provided using an action group.

subcommands.name: submit-feedback
subcommands.description: Sends feedback to CodeGuru Profiler about whether the anomaly detected by the analysis is useful or not.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Use to assign one or more tags to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Use to remove one or more tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-profiling-group
subcommands.description: Updates a profiling group.
